rules.description: Outlines interactive form fields and external elements without competing visually with the text inside them.

insights: The measured palette is entirely monochromatic, relying on stark black, white, and grays to build the UI shell. This effectively forces user-generated imagery to provide all the actual color on the page.

Visual hierarchy and component bounds are established through a wide spectrum of grays—from light structural washes (#E5E5E0) for secondary interactive surfaces down to mid-tones (#62625B) for metadata.

The design commits to absolute black (#000000) for major typography and heavy structural blocks like the footer, resulting in a punchy, high-contrast aesthetic against the white canvas rather than a softer, low-contrast UI.
